packaging.method: 4x2 equal whole-cell crop; one fixed whole-cell LANCZOS downsample per action; full-frame integer x/y registration; no alpha masks, software pose synthesis, body-part deformation, mirroring or interpolation
packaging.order_reason: whole-cell walk reorder places forward contact/weight, under-shoulder, rearward/toe-off, passing and swing phases in a clearer chronological loop; generated running sequence remains in source order
packaging.running_registration: Source phases0,1,3,4,7 register contact foot to228. Source phases2,5,6 translate relative to highest contact foot baseline in their source row; running airborne foot clearance is preserved, not registered to ground.
packaging.runtime_installation: root agent after final visual acceptance; packaging script writes staged assets only

review.identity: Root reviewed and approved IdentityAnchor-v1.png before cycle generation; actual pet.jpg remains primary identity.
review.final: Root reviewed all-actions-contact-160.png, packaging script and validation.json and accepted all four cycles.
review.scale: Fixed action-wide scaling gives reasonably consistent cloud-head sizes at160px (rough visual estimates54–61px); generated camera/fur/face variation remains and no per-frame resize normalization was applied.
review.gait: Walk phase order selected by whole-cell reorder. Runs retain hind gather/push, extended flight, fore landing/compression/push, gathered flight and hind landing; generated quadruped poses are not a hand-rigged exact biomechanical simulation.
review.alpha: Original imagegen RGBA alpha retained through whole-cell resizing; no masking or background removal. Raw alpha0 RGB flecks were assessed on neutral dark composites. Final visible bbox is fully contained; edge alpha maximum0..1.
review.quota: No quota failure and no card redemption.
